title: Read-only cache-options compatibility and repeated-prefix screen
hypothesis: The Codex endpoint accepts and acknowledges documented implicit cache options, enabling later diagnostics or breakpoint experiments.
falsified_if: The field is rejected or unacknowledged; stop before larger context cells. No speed or cache-improvement claim is permitted from mere acceptance.
deterministic_outcomes: nonempty completed final on frozen verified coding tail
efficiency_outcomes: cache hits on identical repeat within one connection
all-attempt reported usage and estimated cost
decision_rule: Custom evals/cache_probe.py and .lua, not campaign.py. Four read-only replay cells, two identical requests per cell (at most eight requests). Simple baseline then treatment is a capability gate; seed 921 randomizes coding pair order. These are frozen final-request replays, NOT fresh coding runs or artifact comparisons. Only added prompt_cache_options differs; distinct stable session keys balance isolation. Pin gpt-6-astra/high and priority from captured requests. Preserve source/request hashes and raw frames outside workspaces. $1 estimated-cost between-cell threshold, 240 active seconds, finite per-request deadlines. Stop immediately on rejected/unacknowledged options, protocol failure, unexpected function calls, unknown usage, cache-write costs, or answer failure. No automatic retries. Compatibility only permits a separately registered diagnostic/explicit-boundary probe; it never promotes defaults. Original cache miss cannot be assigned a backend cause without diagnostic evidence.
